HERO_SUB: Electricity, gas, water, trash — utilities swing hard with the seasons. FincWin's Utilities envelope tracks every bill so winter heating spikes never blindside your budget.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: Summer AC destroys your budget in three months
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: Your electricity bill is $90 in April and $210 in July. You "knew it would be higher" but never built that into your budget. You scramble every August.
PAIN_ITEM_2_H3: The rate increase buried in the fine print
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: Your utility provider raised rates by 8% this quarter. Your bill went from $145 to $157 and you didn't connect the dots until you pulled six months of data.
PAIN_ITEM_3_H3: Water leak you didn't notice for two months
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: Your water bill crept from $40 to $95 over eight weeks. No dramatic flood — just a slow drip you never tracked. The trend would have caught it in week three.
FEATURES_H2:
The Utilities envelope sees
seasonal patterns before you do.
CARD_1_P: Set a higher Utilities cap for winter and summer months. Your budget adapts to reality instead of fighting it every heating season.
CARD_2_P: Never miss a utility payment. Log due dates for electricity, gas, and water. FincWin shows upcoming bills on your dashboard automatically.
CARD_3_P: See your utility costs charted month by month. Spot the slow creep of a rate increase or the spike of a hidden leak before it becomes a problem.
